zh-Hant.name: 炸彈小隊
zh-Hant.summary: 放炸彈、炸磚塊、撿道具，在連鎖爆炸裡活到最後當小隊長！
zh-Hant.controls: 方向鍵／WASD 移動，空白鍵放炸彈；手機用左下搖桿與炸彈鈕

zh-Hans.name: 炸弹小队
zh-Hans.summary: 放炸弹、炸砖块、捡道具，在连锁爆炸里活到最后当小队长！
zh-Hans.controls: 方向键／WASD 移动，空白键放炸弹；手机用左下摇杆与炸弹钮

en.name: Bomb Squad
en.summary: Drop bombs, blast bricks, grab power-ups, and be the last one standing in the chain explosions!
en.controls: Arrow keys / WASD to move, space bar to drop a bomb; on phones use the joystick and bomb button
